summary: Insight Molecular Diagnostics Inc. (iMDx), formerly Oncocyte, filed an 8-K on September 21, 2026 reporting Amendment No. 2 to the April 15, 2021 Merger Agreement under which its Merger Sub merged into Chronix, which became a wholly-owned subsidiary. The amendment, dated September 15, 2026, renegotiates earnout obligations owed Chronix equity holders — altering the 10% royalty on CNI Monitor sales, patent-transfer proceeds, and milestone payments. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed, and no independent deal emerges; terms remain a legacy contingent-consideration restructuring. Watch for liability reductions and any future Chronix-related payments.
